preconditions: Ordered finite route samples in the same projected CRS
decisionLogic: Evaluate contact elevation only for route samples inside or on the evidence convex hull.
Report hull-entry and hull-exit locations as station brackets between samples, not exact intersections.
uncertainty: Coverage-transition precision is bounded by route sample spacing and remains distinct from geological uncertainty
exclusions: No automatic interpolation across unsupported gaps
No claim of exact hull intersection
validationMethod: Straight, bent, outside, boundary and invalid-order route tests
reopenCondition: Exact polyline-hull intersections or adaptive route resampling are required
